title: 2-Digit Addition With Regrouping Worksheets
intro: Teach regrouping in addition as an exchange of ten ones for one ten.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Combine two collections of tens and ones. When the ones total ten or more, make a new ten and record it in the tens column.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

36: 3 tens and 6 ones.

27: 2 tens and 7 ones.

6 + 7 = 13 ones
13 ones = 1 ten + 3 ones
3 tens + 2 tens + 1 ten = 6 tens
36 + 27 = 63

Ask your student

Where did the extra ten come from?

If your student needs help

If the student forgets the new ten, have them match each written digit to the blocks.
